newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX firm as April tests $21.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX firm as April tests $21.

text.p: Brent crude futures were indicated steady at midday on Tuesday compared with London's close, while April NYMEX crude was trading around the key chart point of $21.00.
April Brent on SIMEX was untraded but quoted at $19.45/$19.60 per barrel after London closed down 24 cents at $19.48.
However, Brent values were in line with the overnight arbitrage against the NYMEX May contract. An arbitrage of $1.35 implied a Brent value of $19.55 in Asia.
NYMEX April crude was last traded at $20.94, up two cents from New York after earlier pushing as high as $21.13 to test upside potential.

NYMEX April crude, which expires on Thursday, has been trying to close above the psychological level of $21.00 since last week, as a building block for testing the top end of the current trading range of $21.45 to $20.00.
